name: Shivansh Chaudhary
summary: B.Arch. undergraduate at IIT Kharagpur (graduating 2028) with three back-to-back remote internships in Growth, GTM and Founder's Office roles. Builds AI/automation pipelines (n8n, web scraping, LinkedIn signal mining) to drive outbound lead generation and qualification. Comfortable with Python/SQL, ML basics, and case-based business strategy.

bullets: Built AI GTM agents using n8n to track 10,000+ weekly hiring signals across LinkedIn and other job platforms for outbound lead generation.
Built LinkedIn Pain Signal Watcher that analyzed 500+ HR leader posts and reduced manual efforts by 70% via automated outreach drafting.
Built a Hiring Stress Signal Detector for repeated leadership changes and funding-led hiring surges to prioritize 200+ high-intent accounts.
Utilized web scraping tools to extract and qualify data for 500+ leads, contributing to a 25% increase in pipeline for outreach campaigns.
Conducted industry research on 12+ competitors, enabling data-driven decisions that improved business planning accuracy by 15%.
Designed and executed targeted email campaigns for 300+ prospects, resulting in a 15% improvement in response rates and engagement.
Executed expansion into 11 European and 3 USA cities, diversified into 5+ genres, and optimized for PMF through data-driven scaling strategies.
Automated artist conversation and qualification using n8n, increasing lead qualification rate by 60% and reducing processing time by 80%.
Automated the artist outreach process using Phantoms, reducing manual effort by 70% and significantly improving lead acquisition efficiency.
Worked with a team of 38 Core Organizing Team Members, expanding Spring Fest's reach to 1000+ colleges across the country.
Solely responsible for conducting the Nation Wide Prelims (Hitch Hike) in Lucknow with a YoY increase in participants of 52%.
Spearheaded the Delhi sponsorship drive, garnering funds via alumni contribution worth INR 7.5 Lakh+, a 30% YoY increase.
Ensured smooth execution of Tell a Tale, SF Idols and Banter Bout at SN Bose Auditorium and raised INR 2 Lakhs through partnership deals.
Led and coordinated a team of 50 Associate members, expanding fest reach to 1000+ colleges and publishing 200+ media articles across India.
Secured and hosted a USA-based artist for International Carnival entirely through international grants, without paying a performance fee.

competitions.title: Gold Medalist — Case-a-Blanca (Supply Chain Case Competition)
bullets: Designed end-to-end supply chain visibility dashboards, enhancing operational resilience by mitigating geopolitical risks and market losses.
Developed logistic-regression-based risk models to reduce unplanned downtime by 21 days through vulnerability management programs.

projects.name: Diabetes Prediction using Support Vector Machines (SVMs)
bullets: Developed a diabetes prediction pipeline using the Pima dataset (768 samples, 8 features) with preprocessing, scaling, modeling and evaluation.
Tuned an RBF-kernel SVM via exhaustive grid search optimization, achieving cross-validation accuracy of 82% and ROC-AUC score of 0.86.
Evaluated on the test set: 81.5% accuracy, 78% recall, 80% precision, and 0.79 F1-score — demonstrating reliable model performance.
